title: Allan Sandler's Vandenberg Atlas rocket disc footage
summary: James Fox tells of Allan Sandler's Vandenberg Atlas rocket disc footage, about 1970s; escrow attempt c. 2013-2014 at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: The Vandenberg missile film in Alan Sandler's vault

plain: James Fox, a UFO investigator, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2024 about film footage linked to a man named Allan Sandler showing the launch of an Atlas rocket, a US military and space rocket, at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California in the 1970s. Fox says the footage shows what he thinks are two discs flying around the tip of the rocket, and that around 2013 or 2014 there was an attempt to place it in escrow, held by a third party while a deal was arranged. If true, it would mean unknown craft were shadowing US rocket launches.
